region.description: The region where the Linode will be created.

image.description: The image to deploy with. Required if no backup_id is provided.

label.description: The label for the new Linode instance.

root_pass.description: The root password for the new Linode instance.

authorized_keys.description: A list of public SSH keys to deploy with.

authorized_users.description: A list of usernames whose SSH keys to deploy.

stackscript_id.description: A StackScript ID to deploy with.

backup_id.description: A backup ID to restore from.

backups_enabled.description: Whether to enable the backup service.

private_ip.description: Whether to assign a private IPv4 address.

booted.description: Whether the new Linode should be booted after creation.
